versions.changelog: Add security controls: explicit pre-checkout confirmation gate, security disclosure section, Chrome profile warnings, and calendar event trust/spoofing notice.

food-cal-order v1.0.0

- Initial release: enables food delivery ordering triggered by calendar events, using browser automation.
- Supports Direct mode (specific service/restaurant) and Discovery mode (criteria-based search).
- Parses calendar title and description to determine mode, extract order details, constraints, and critical allergy/dietary info.
- Integrates with DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub.
- Spawns sub-agents for parallel recon across services and for order execution.
- Enforces strict allergy and dietary rules for safety.
